entities.summary: Elie Saab is a fashion designer based in Lebanon. He started his business in the early 1980s, and specialized in bridal couture. His work includes the use of materials such as lace, gemstones, crystals, pearls, and embroidery. Elie Saab was a performers & entertainers from Beirut (b. 1964-07-04, Beirut). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
